summary: Comprehensive testing of NAPP 2FA (Two-Factor Authentication) system completed. Backend: 12/12 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All 2FA features working correctly - Settings page 2FA section, setup dialog with QR code, login 2FA verification screen, and admin 2FA endpoints.

backend: User 2FA setup returns QR code and secret (POST /api/auth/2fa/setup)
User 2FA verify enables 2FA with backup codes (POST /api/auth/2fa/verify)
User login without 2FA code when enabled returns requires_2fa: true
User login with valid 2FA code succeeds
User 2FA disable works with valid code (POST /api/auth/2fa/disable)
frontend: Login page loads correctly with data-testid attributes
Settings page loads with Security section
Settings page shows Two-Factor Authentication section
Settings page shows 'Disabled' badge when 2FA is off
Settings page shows 'Enable 2FA' button when 2FA is off
2FA Setup dialog opens when clicking Enable 2FA
2FA Setup dialog shows QR code image
2FA Setup dialog shows secret code (hidden by default)
2FA Setup dialog has eye icon to reveal secret
2FA Setup dialog has copy button for secret
2FA Setup dialog has 6-digit code input field
2FA Setup dialog has Cancel and Verify & Enable buttons
Login page shows 2FA verification screen when 2FA is required
2FA verification screen has 'Back to login' button
2FA verification screen has '2FA Verification' title
2FA verification screen has Authentication Code input
2FA verification screen has 'Verify & Sign In' button
2FA verification screen has backup code hint
Back button on 2FA screen returns to login form
Admin login page loads correctly
Admin login redirects to admin dashboard

critical_code_review_comments: 2FA implementation uses pyotp library for TOTP generation - REAL implementation, not mocked
Backup codes are 8 codes in format XXXX-XXXX, stored in MongoDB
2FA secret stored in user document as 'totp_secret' when enabled
Login flow correctly returns requires_2fa: true when 2FA is enabled but no code provided
Both user and admin 2FA endpoints follow same pattern
Frontend correctly handles pending2FA state in AuthContext
seed_data_creation: Test user reftest@napp.io has 2FA DISABLED after testing (was enabled and disabled during test)
context_for_next_testing_agent: 2FA system fully tested and working. Backend endpoints: POST /api/auth/2fa/setup (returns QR code, secret, provisioning_uri), POST /api/auth/2fa/verify (enables 2FA, returns 8 backup codes), GET /api/auth/2fa/status (returns enabled state, backup_codes_remaining), POST /api/auth/2fa/disable (requires valid code). Admin has same endpoints under /api/admin/auth/2fa/*. Frontend Settings page has 2FA section with Enable/Disable button, setup dialog with QR code. Login page shows 2FA verification screen when required. Test user reftest@napp.io currently has 2FA DISABLED.
